title: Takebook
user: Music teachers and pairs practicing a short piano phrase together who need to keep, annotate, and reopen takes without a DAW.
smallest_useful_product: Web MIDI piano-roll recorder: record up to 60 seconds, loop a marked bar range, attach a teacher note, and export standard MIDI/WAV.
monetization: freemium — free local takes; teacher pack adds folders and printable practice sheets.
constraints: Must work with the computer keyboard; local by default; original synthesized audio only.
